Google Tasks to Ziffr

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address, the Webhook's id and secret, and the id of the task list (`@default` is your main list).
2. Add the Google Tasks credential to the List tasks node.
3. Activate the workflow. Every 5 minutes it tells Ziffr which tasks were ticked or un-ticked, and passes on a line starting "Reply:" in a task's notes.

Self-hosted n8n: set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto. Details: docs/automations/google-tasks.md
